kp: abbr. 鍵控脈衝（Key Pulse）；鍵盤穿孔機（Keyboard Perforator）；公里標杆（Kilometer Post）
n an enlisted person who is assigned to assist the cooks
<dl class="nd"><dt>典故</dt><dd>From 'kitchen police', a name for the soldiers. 源自 kitchen police （幫廚兵）一詞。</dd></dl>
kph: abbr. (=kilometers per hour) 千米/小時, 公里/小時; (=knots per hour) 節/小時
n the ratio of the distance traveled (in kilometers) to the time spent traveling (in hours)
